thread:
rachel: Heads-up: ISO auditor (DELOITTE) asked for a short evidence bundle covering: RBAC change from Mar 9, KMS key lifecycle events around that time, vuln triage notes for related CVEs, and the incident response timeline. They want a one-paragraph narrative plus artifacts and hashes. Who can assemble a minimal, redacted package?

dan: I can do the RBAC diffs + k8s audit slice. Scope: `prod` and `staging` only?

priya: yes, prod + staging. Auditor asked for sample-based evidence only (not full dump). Provide the RBAC diff between commit `a1b2c3` and `d4e5f6`, include approver in PR metadata.

sec-bot: checklist: include: PR link & approver, k8s rolebinding snapshots (pre/post), k8s audit log slice (timestamp window 2026-03-09T09:00Z..2026-03-09T10:30Z), CloudKMS version list, key rotation event IDs, vuln triage summary, incident-timeline.txt, README-chainofcustody.md, sha256 sums of artifacts. Redact wallet/customer ids.

rachel: for KMS export, use: `gcloud kms keys versions list --key=ci-backup-enc --location=global --keyring=prod-kr --format=json --filter="createTime>=2026-03-09T00:00:00Z"` and the audit log filter for `UpdateCryptoKeyVersion` events.

dan: pulled RBAC diffs and audit slice. Small note: the RBAC change was part of a rollout that also touched a service account rename; I replaced service-account email with `<REDACTED-SVC>` in the artifact.

priya: vuln triage: CVE-2026-0147 touched a library used by the deployment tooling. Ticket SEC-4430: patched to 2.5.0, backported hotfix to staging, and scheduled full rollout. Added triage notes to SEC-4430-triage.md.

mark: incident response note: on 2026-03-09 09:12Z we detected failed automated deploy -> pager fired (INC-7701), investigation found a misconfigured rolebinding causing deploy denial. We performed an emergency rollback and applied corrected rolebinding. No customer data involved. Timeline included in `incident-timeline.txt`.

rachel: assembling bundle now. Creating minimal ZIP with files: rbacs-pre-post.yaml, rbac-diff.patch, k8s-audit-slice.json, kms-versions.json, kms-events.log, SEC-4430-triage.md, incident-timeline.txt, README-chainofcustody.md.

sec-bot: policy reminder: artifacts to auditor must be hashed and redacted. Raw exports go to internal-sec S3 path; auditor gets hashed bundle + README. Retention: 7 years for ISO evidence.

rachel: uploaded internal bundle to s3://redwood-internal-audit/iso-2026/evidence-1771000123/raw/ and the auditor bundle to s3://redwood-audit-deliverables/iso-2026/evidence-1771000123/auditor.zip. README includes: who exported (rachel), UTC export time 2026-03-12T11:05:00Z, export commands, redaction notes (replaced service emails with <REDACTED-SVC>), and sha256s.

priya: sha256s pasted in README: auditor.zip -> `e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855` (sample placeholder). All PII removed.

auditor-simon: thanks team, please also provide the CI/CD run id for the rollout and the PR permalink for the RBAC change so we can cross-verify.

dan: CI run id is `ci-20260309-2287`. PR permalink: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/merge/5879 (approver: priya). Both included in README and metadata file.

auditor-simon: good. one follow-up: can you confirm whether any key material export occurred around the key events? we need confirmation that no `CryptoKey` export was performed.

priya: confirmed: KMS audit slice shows `UpdateCryptoKeyVersion` only; no `ImportCryptoKeyVersion` or `CryptoKey` export calls. Included a short verification snippet in README: "no export API calls found in filtered logs" plus the log grep command used.

mark: added the incident postmortem link (internal) in README, redacted per policy.

rachel: final step: DMing auditor the public bundle link and adding an entry in control mapping doc (ISO A.9 and A.10) referencing this evidence.

auditor-simon: received the bundle, starting review. likely follow-ups but this looks like a concise sample for now.

sec-bot: ticket SEC-4430 state -> evidence-delivered

dan: thanks everyone. leaving a short note in confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/ISO+Evidence+Index

rachel: closing thread. if auditor reopens, we'll attach additional samples. thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
